<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the dominant ion is at m/z 179.0946, which corresponds to a [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 178.0873 Da. The formula that matches this mass most closely is C₁₁H₁₄O₂ (exact mass 178.0994 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). No other heteroatoms are indicated, so the molecular formula is simply C11H14O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2</final_answer>
